Hmm unsure about this contribution the existing dissector deals with bthci extensions as far as I can understand. The additions talks about Bluetooth LE Apple so perhaps not the same thing and should mot exist in this file? A sample pcap might help.

@AndersBroman FWIW I would suggest that because this is including something which can, and does, change over time, as it is just a proprietary thing which has been reverse engineered, that it probably does not make sense to include in baseline Wireshark, as it will quickly become inaccurate and confusing. People wishing to parse such messages can simply use existing Wireshark plugins like https://github.com/furiousMAC/continuity, which are most likely the basis for this MR. (Note the comment "Apple updates Continuity frequently, adding new messages and field values.")
